name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The Diablillos project hosts a significant silver-gold resource that has been approved under Argentina's Large Investment program. The company is advancing toward a feasibility study and final investment decision, with active drilling programs continuing to expand the resource.
